question: The decision to shift the capital of India from Calcutta to Delhi was announced at a Durbar held in ________ in 1911 to celebrate the coronation of King George V.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The decision to shift the capital of British India from **Calcutta (Kolkata) to Delhi **was announced during the Delhi Durbar of 1911.
 
• It was held to celebrate the coronation of** King George V and Queen Mary** as Emperor and Empress of India.
 
• The shift of the capital from **Calcutta to Delhi officially took place in 1931.**
 
• Delhi was designed by architects** Edwin Lutyens and Herbert Baker**, was inaugurated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kolkata** (then Calcutta) was the capital of British India from 1772 to 1911.
 
• Known as the Cultural Capital of India, Kolkata is home to renowned institutions such as the Indian Museum,** the National Library**, and **Victoria Memorial.**
 
• **Mysore** was the capital of the Kingdom of Mysore, ruled by the** Wodeyar dynasty** for over six centuries, except during the rule of Tipu Sultan and his father **Hyder Ali.**
 
• The Mysore Palace, an architectural marvel, is one of the most visited monuments in India. It was rebuilt in the early 20th century after a fire and is known for its Indo-Saracenic style.
 
• **Tipu Sultan** was Known as the **Tiger of Mysore,** Tipu Sultan was a prominent ruler who fought against British colonization.
 
• **Kanpur** became a significant industrial city under British rule, known for its textile and leather industries. It earned the title **“Manchester of the East”** due to its thriving textile mills.
 
• Kanpur played a critical role in the** Indian Rebellion of 1857** (First War of Independence).
